Email Signatures

Find your name below and click Download. Then, in Outlook:
  1. Open the downloaded file and select all (Ctrl+A), then copy (Ctrl+C).
  2. Go to File → Options → Mail → Signatures.
  3. Create a new signature, paste the copied content, then click OK.
  4. Set it as your default signature for new messages and replies.
